# Quizlet Gravity

> Import a public Quizlet set link, paste a term list, or upload a CSV — no account needed. Defend your planet from falling asteroids by typing the correct answers in this free recreation of Quizlet's Gravity study mode (2020–2024 era).

Quizlet Gravity is a free, single-player educational typing game. Players import a public Quizlet set using its link, paste term/definition pairs, or upload a CSV, then answer prompts to destroy asteroids before they hit the planet. Gameplay and saved cards stay in the browser; public Quizlet link imports use a server-side Firecrawl integration. No Quizlet Gravity account is required. It recreates the look and mechanics of Quizlet's retired Gravity mode, including difficulty scaling, streak-based scoring, copy-the-answer on misses, and a session leaderboard.

## Key facts

- Name: Quizlet Gravity
- URL: https://www.quizletgravity.com
- Price: Free (no account, no ads, no in-app purchases)
- Platforms: Any web browser — desktop and mobile
- Genre: Educational / typing / arcade study game
- Difficulty levels: Sloth, Easy, Medium, Hard, Mad Max
- Scoring: 20 × consecutive-correct streak + 150 × (1 + level bonus); wrong answers −10 points
- Terms per level: 7; gravity starts at 9.8 (Hard: 11, Mad Max: 12.2) and rises 0.2 per level
- Privacy: saved term sets are stored in the browser's localStorage; public Quizlet link imports are processed server-side using Firecrawl
- Author: Marko Sarafijanovic (markosaraf)
- Source code: https://github.com/markosaraf/quizletgravityLAUNCH
- License: MIT

## How to play

1. Import a public Quizlet set link, paste terms and definitions (one per line, separated by comma, semicolon, dash, or tab), or upload a CSV.
2. Fix any mis-parsed rows in the editable terms table; star terms to study only those.
3. Click "Start studying", pick a difficulty and the answer side, then "Start".
4. Type each answer to destroy the asteroid before it lands.
5. On a miss, type the correct answer in the copy-the-answer modal to continue; miss the same term twice and the game ends.
6. Press ESC to skip a term you don't know.

## FAQ

- **Do I need a Quizlet account?** No — the game runs entirely in the browser with no sign-up.
- **How do I import terms?** Import a public Quizlet set by pasting its link, paste one term/definition pair per line (comma, semicolon, dash, or tab separator), or upload a CSV. At least 2 pairs are required.
- **What happens on a miss?** A copy-the-answer modal appears; type the correct answer to keep playing. Missing the same term twice ends the game.
- **Does it work on mobile?** Yes, the layout is fully responsive, with a dark/light mode toggle.
- **Where are my cards stored?** Saved cards stay in your browser's localStorage. When you import a public Quizlet set link, the server uses Firecrawl to retrieve that set. Pasted terms and local CSV files are processed in your browser.
